Dear [Mr Palgrave](/person/1124)
I am afraid your Lyme Garland may have been waiting some time for my return from a course of visits, as I only found it on my coming home on Saturday

Thank you exceedingly for the kind remembrance The music of your verse always charms me, I think my special favorites are the primroses and the lament for the Baby

yours very truly

C M Yonge
